name: Cartethyia

tierList.prydwen: T0.5 Tower of Adversity, T1.5 Whimpering Wastes - regarded as the highest damage-ceiling DPS in the game

kit.intro: 5-star Aero Sword Main DPS, uniquely scales off HP instead of ATK. Cartethyia form gathers 3 'Sword Shadows' (Discord/Divinity/Virtue) consumed via Mid-air Attack to buff her transformed 'Fleurdelys' form (Ultimate, 12s Manifest, own Forte 'Conviction' up to 120 unlocking a second Ultimate). Deep Aero Erosion synergy - damage scales with erosion stacks on enemies.

skills.normalAttack: Sword to Carve My Forms - Cartethyia form 4-hit chain (applies Aero Erosion + summons Sword Shadows); Fleurdelys form gets its own 5-hit chain restoring Conviction.
skills.resonanceSkill: Sword to Bear Their Names - Aero DMG + Aero Erosion, summons Sword of Virtue; Fleurdelys variant is a 2-part force-field pull (Sword to Answer Waves' Call -> May Tempest Break the Tides).
skills.forte: Tempest - governs the Fleurdelys transformed moveset and Conviction gauge.
skills.liberation: A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers - transforms into Fleurdelys (costs 50% current HP) for 12s; second Ultimate 'Blade of Howling Squall' at 120 Conviction consumes all Aero Erosion stacks for up to +100% DMG and restores 50% Max HP.
skills.intro: Sword to Mark Tide's Trace - Aero DMG + 2 Aero Erosion stacks, summons Sword of Discord.
skills.outro: Wind's Divine Blessing - +17.5% Aero DMG Amplify to next character vs targets with Negative Status, for 20s.

bestWeapons: Defier's Thorn (signature, 100%, uniquely gives HP% scaling)
Guardian Sword (F2P last resort, only other HP% Sword)
echoSet: Windward Pilgrimage (5pc, best for Aero Erosion DPS)

teams.name: Team #1
teams.notes: Ciaccona is her non-negotiable best partner (constant off-field Aero Erosion application + Outro amplifies erosion damage 100%); Shorekeeper preferred in multi-wave Whimpering Wastes.

teams.name: Team #2: F2P Alternative
teams.notes: Sanhua provides fast-rotating field time and Basic DMG buffing, best budget option even without erosion synergy.

rotation: Intro -> Basic P2-P4 -> Skill -> Mid-air Attack (consumes Sword Shadows) -> Ultimate (transform to Fleurdelys) -> Skill 1 -> Mid-air P3 -> Skill 2 -> Basic P3-P5 x2 cycles -> 2nd Ultimate (Blade of Howling Squall) -> Outro. Rich swap-cancel windows allow quickswap-friendly play (e.g. with Changli or Aero Rover).
communityNotes: Prydwen: rated the single best/highest-ceiling DPS in the game in her optimal team, self-sufficient enough to perform well even without ideal teammates, but very expensive to build (unique HP%-scaling gear, near-mandatory signature weapon, requires unconventional teammate builds) and can struggle maintaining Aero Erosion stacks in AoE/Whimpering Wastes scenarios where enemies die in bulk.
